tagline: LAN with your friends, as if you're in the same room
brief: A Windows app that puts friends on one virtual LAN through a relay server in Iran, so LAN games work with low ping. The audience is gamer friends. The feel: fast, friendly, sleek, a bit of night-time neon.
criteria: Distinct from globes, gamepads and wifi icons; readable at 16 px; works in one colour; neon green on near-black.

concepts.name: Route F
concepts.idea: An F drawn as a route map: every terminal is a player.
rationale: Says the name (F) and the job (one route connecting several players)
Neon green on near-black: gamer night-time, but restrained and sleek
Separate heavier small-size cut for favicon and Windows icon

recommendation: Route F in neon green #39FF6E on night #0A0F0C; deep green #00A846 on light backgrounds.
next_steps: Use the icon in the app
